coaching.headline: Two majors conceded with five alive, three fights fought two-on-two, and a 1-29 river split: towers ended 0-11.
coaching.team: We lost this in the uncontested minutes. The first Fangtooth was ours at 5. Then Fangtooth at 11 and Mini Prime at 15 both fell with all five of us alive and nobody there to contest either one. Scarlett was caught alone by Countess three times before minute twelve, the first costing Mini Prime at 7.8. The fight at 16.2, won 2-1 by GRIM.exe and Maco, bought Fangtooth at 17, the only fight we converted all game. But it ran two-on-two while three lanes sat unanswered, and an outer tower, an inner tower and an inhibitor fell within the next minute. Primal Fangtooth went the same way at 22.2: GRIM.exe and Maco again alone, lost 1-2, with Scarlett and Willy both alive and never in it. The last fight, at 31.9, repeated it: Shinbi and GRIM.exe lost the Inhibitor 0-2 while Scarlett and Xeebs stood by. River control finished 1-29, towers 0-11. Next game: get five bodies to the fight, every time.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: What decided this? Two majors, Fangtooth at 11 and Mini Prime at 15, fell uncontested with all five of us alive. Then three fights were fought two-on-two, one won and two lost, while three teammates weren't in them each time. That pattern cost more than any single death.
coaching.whatWorked: The fight at 16.2: GRIM.exe and Maco killed Khaimera and Wraith 2-1, and it bought Fangtooth at 17, the only won fight cashed into a prize all game.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Maco skipped the meta core, Crescelia, Enra's Blessing and Windcaller, for Hexbound Bracers, Gaia Greaves, Gaussian Greaves and Everbloom: more health, armor and healing, over the core's poke damage and Enra's Blessing's shield on a locked-down ally. None of it carried magic resist against three magical damage sources.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.eternal: The engine doesn't model support Eternals; the field's most common pick on Maco support is Exarch.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: GRIM.exe skipped the meta's Lightning Hawk and Dust Devil, both on-hit attack-speed tools, for Necrosis, Nuclear Rounds and Spear Of Desolation, three items that all buff ultimate and ability damage instead. It still produced the team's top hero damage at 23,009, so the swap wasn't what cost this one.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: The engine's top pick for GRIM.exe carry is Demiurge, scaling power and item-effect damage from his build, fitting a hybrid who leans on item-driven burst in both his marksman and mage modes, ahead of Thraex's on-hit-focused alternative.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: No established core exists for Scarlett offlane, so there's no meta swap to grade. The build ran health and physical power (Tainted Guard, Overlord, Terminus, Syonic Echo) with zero magic resist against three magical damage sources, the gap behind the early solo catches.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.eternal: The engine's top pick for Scarlett offlane is Krix, flat bonus health that scales per level, fitting an island role graded on survival over the early catches that cost this game its first Mini Prime.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Shinbi built two of the three core items, Spirit Of Amir and Oathkeeper, and swapped Wraith Leggings for Magnify: more max health and omnivamp against magical damage, at the cost of the flat power and penetration Wraith Leggings gives. Neither fixes the missing magic resist against The Fey.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: The engine's top pick for Shinbi jungle is Krix, flat bonus health scaling per level, fitting a bruiser who's squishy once her shield drops and was caught alone twice tonight, ahead of Demiurge's item-damage scaling.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: On core, nothing to teach here for Renna: Entropy, Wraith Leggings and Overseer match the winning build exactly.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: The engine's top pick for Renna midlane is Demiurge, which scales power and item-effect damage from her build, fitting a late-scaling ability-power mage over Vesh's ability-damage-over-time burst alternative.

ranking.grade: Best on the roster: Maco held eighty percent kill participation, zero deaths before minute ten, and out-warded the enemy support 19 wards to 14.
Second: GRIM.exe led the team with 23,009 damage to heroes and won the only fight we converted all game, at 16.2.
Third: Scarlett's three early solo catches cost Mini Prime, but the offlane held after minute twelve.
Fourth: Willy's one solo catch handed over Primal Fangtooth and Orb Prime, on zero wards placed all game.
Fifth: Renna's five deaths were all solo catches, zero assists, and two of them cost towers late.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.8s of lockdown): Countess Feast (suppress 0.75s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Steel. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 1 item of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Countess. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Maco) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Our damage is 4/5 magical — predictable; one magic-resist item answers most of it. Mix in a physical threat.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Maco Gift! (heal ally / hurt enemy) → Maco Fly! slam → Maco Strike! charged line ult
ourKits.winCondition: poke and heal-flex while landing the charged ult
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the charged Strike; pressure his low survivability

ourKits.combo: Energy Shield block → Displacement Blast → Assault Mode → GTFO lockon ult
ourKits.winCondition: out-trade with Pulsefire and the spell-shield, finish with GTFO
ourKits.playWith: peel so he can free-cast in Assault Mode
ourKits.playAgainst: bait Energy Shield, then commit; dodge GTFO's slow channel

ourKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
ourKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

ourKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
ourKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
ourKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
ourKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
ourKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

enemyKits.combo: Peekaboo! mark+slow → Knock, Knock! sniper → Back It Up! displacement ult
enemyKits.winCondition: land long-range snipes on marked targets and reset on takedowns
enemyKits.playWith: engage that holds a target in his sniper line
enemyKits.playAgainst: close the gap — he's weak point-blank; dodge the skillshot snipe

enemyKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
enemyKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
enemyKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
enemyKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
enemyKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Harvest Nettles stacks → Untamed Growth DoT → Fly Trap pull ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Fly Trap a clumped team and detonate AoE on the pull
enemyKits.passive: takedowns spawn growths + grant move speed
enemyKits.playWith: engage that clumps for her Fly Trap
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread out vs the pull; she's squishy — dive her

enemyKits.combo: Shadow Slip in → Eventide → Blade Siphon → Feast suppress ult, Haemorrhage true-damage
enemyKits.winCondition: Feast-suppress a squishy and delete them with true-damage burst
enemyKits.passive: two-ability hits apply a %max-HP true-damage bleed
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up after her pick
enemyKits.playAgainst: Feast is her whole engage — bait it / peel; she's fragile, punish the recast window
